explainer.title: A word before you go on
explainer.body: May we send a quiet note when your Manna is full, a rare gentle reminder, and news of new chapters and events? Never at night, never often. You can change this any time in Settings.

manna_full.title: Your Manna is full again
manna_full.body: Esther's rooftop is quiet and ready, whenever you are.

come_back.title: Word from the bakehouse
come_back.body: Silas has a story half told, and Esther's rooftop is just as you left it. Come by whenever you like.

settings.title: Settings
settings.sound_hint: Soft chimes when you merge, deliver an order or finish a task.
settings.haptics_hint: A small tap you can feel when something happens on the board.
settings.tier_numbers_hint: Shows each item's level in its corner, so matching pairs are easier to spot.
settings.reminders_hint: When your Manna is full, or a rare note after a few days away.
settings.events_hint: When a new event begins, and a day before one you joined ends.
settings.chapters_hint: When the next part of Naomi's story is ready to play.
settings.blocked: Notifications for Whispers of Joppa are turned off on this phone. To get them, turn them on in your phone's Settings.
